message.content: {"note_claim": "There are no confirmed cases of popcorn lung caused by vaping, and diacetyl is banned in regulated e-liquids.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "There have been no confirmed cases of popcorn lung linked to e-cigarettes.", "reason": "The Cancer Research UK page directly states no confirmed cases are linked to e-cigarettes and that diacetyl was banned in UK e-liquids under the TPD in 2016."}

parsed.note_claim: There are no confirmed cases of popcorn lung caused by vaping, and diacetyl is banned in regulated e-liquids.
